name: Emergency rescue action
explanation: Immediate emergency escalation or rescue maneuver (high oxygen, suction, or senior assistance) under acute physiological distress.

name: Empirical oxygen titration under uncertainty
explanation: Oxygen titration titrated to pulse oximetry before blood gas confirmation has returned.

name: Excessive tidal volume in injured lung
explanation: Setting tidal volume > 10 mL/kg PBW in acute lung injury significantly increases cyclical alveolar shear stress and barotrauma mortality.
source: ARDS Network. N Engl J Med 2000;342:1301-8

name: Abrupt derecruitment in severe hypoxaemia
explanation: Abruptly reducing PEEP to minimal levels while the patient is dependent on high FiO2 promotes catastrophic alveolar derecruitment.
